changes_made.explanation: Removed duplicate model entries (KEEP-IT-SIMPLE (KIS) and HIPORANK (HR)) since they're already covered by SIMPLIFY (KEEP-IT-SIMPLE) and SELECT (HIPORANK). Normalized task name from 'Other:Text Simplification' to 'Text Simplification' and simplified output descriptions.
Normalized 'BERT-score' to 'BERTScore' for consistency. The paper uses ROUGE (R1, R2, RL), BERTScore, and Flesch Kincaid Reading Ease as automatic evaluation metrics.
No LLM-as-judge evaluation was used in this paper. The paper only uses automatic metrics and human evaluation.

guideline: Annotators evaluated summaries on a 1-5 Likert scale for Relevance, Fluency, Simplicity, and Overall Ranking compared to reference summaries

changes_made.explanation: Removed duplicate criteria entries and normalized to title case. Consolidated guideline description to a single comprehensive statement.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on Cross-lingual Science Journalism (CSJ) as a combination of text simplification and cross-lingual scientific summarization. The SSR pipeline (SELECT, SIMPLIFY, REWRITE) is the main contribution. Evaluation includes both automatic metrics (ROUGE, BERTScore, readability scores) and human evaluation. The extraction was generally accurate with minor normalization needed for consistency.
